tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Window background — the drop area and lists sit directly on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, transfer rows, menus and the send sheet.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only — not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, the dashed drop-zone outline (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: File sizes, timestamps, helper text — on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: fling
tokens.usage: The brand. Primary action (Send), active drop zone, links; as text on surface, surface-raised or fling-soft.

tokens.name: fling-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the drop zone while a file hovers over it, selected rows.

tokens.name: on-fling
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a fling fill (the Send button).

tokens.name: arc
tokens.usage: Transfer progress fill and the in-flight indicator. A fill only — never text on the light surfaces. Text on an arc fill is #1E1C1A in both themes (9.4:1).

tokens.name: on-arc
tokens.usage: Icons drawn on an arc fill, such as the up arrow in the sending disc. Arc is light in both themes, so this stays dark.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Delivered / verified state — check icon and its label, on surface and surface-raised.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Ubuntu, sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: The platform's own UI face, so Fling feels native on macOS, Windows and Linux. Five steps, no more.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The empty-state headline in the drop zone. Once per window.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 3 files are on their way. You can close the window.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, status lines, helper text — in ink-muted.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Tabular figures for anything that counts up.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: File sizes, speeds, time remaining, share codes.

spacing.note: 4px base; four steps cover a compact desktop window.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, between a file name and its size.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between stacked rows of a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and row padding, gaps between controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window padding and between sections.

radius.note: Soft rectangles; pills only for small status things.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, progress tracks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, transfer rows, the drop zone.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars of receiving devices.

shadow.note: One elevation, only for things that float above the window.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, the send sheet, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px window-colour gap, then 2px of fling.
